units.source_text: 昼间贺客盈门，竟日骚扰。

en.t: During the day, congratulatory visitors filled the house, causing commotion from morning until night.

units.source_text: 源氏于夕暮之时始得访问各位夫人。

en.t: Only at dusk was Genji finally able to visit each of the ladies.

units.source_text: 但见她们都打扮得花枝招展，倩影娉婷，令人百看不厌。

en.t: He found them all beautifully dressed, their graceful figures so charming that he could never tire of looking at them.

units.source_text: 他对紫夫人说：“今晨众侍女嬉笑祝颂，其乐融融，甚可欣羡。

en.t: He said to Lady Murasaki, "This morning the maidservants laughed and offered their congratulations, looking so happy together that one could hardly help envying them.

units.source_text: 现在我也来替你祝颂了。”

en.t: Now I have come to offer my congratulations to you as well."

units.source_text: 便带几分玩笑态度歌诵祝词。

en.t: Then, with a somewhat playful air, he chanted words of blessing.
He also presented a poem, saying:
